item.title: Spray It And Say It
item.description: Read Spray It And Say It I wanted to clean my keyboard, so I grabbed the office compressed air can and went to town while sort of dangling the keyboard by the wire (yes, old school, not wireless). Anyway, it seemed to be blowing diddly squat out of the keyboard, and seconds after making that observation, I stopped spraying as I realized I was using spray adhesive. Totally jacked up the keyboard. Read Spray It And Say It

item.title: This Is Why We Can’t Have Nice Toilets
item.description: Read This Is Why We Can’t Have Nice Toilets Mother: "But he’s a child! He really can’t hold it!" Manager: "We made an exception last week for a customer with the exact same story. They left the staff restroom in such a disgusting state that we had to call a hazardous waste cleaner." Read This Is Why We Can’t Have Nice Toilets

item.title: Don’t Bring A Grudge To A Potluck
item.description: Read Don’t Bring A Grudge To A Potluck Senior Accountant: "Did you tell the cleaning guy he could eat at the potluck?" Me: "Yeah, why?" Senior Accountant: "He's a cleaner. He's here to empty garbage cans and clean toilets, not to mooch off of food that's meant for the OFFICE workers." Read Don’t Bring A Grudge To A Potluck

item.title: Expecting A Stream Of Abuse
item.description: Read Expecting A Stream Of Abuse Me: "Hi, I believe I can exchange this SodaStream cartridge for a new one?" The employee nods but looks a bit nervous. Employee: "You can, but it's not free. There's a discount for the exchange, but you have to pay something." Read Expecting A Stream Of Abuse

item.title: A Tale Of Two Cities
item.description: Read A Tale Of Two Cities Guest: "Did they name the town Boston after the city in the USA to honour the American servicemen?" Friend: "Uh, Boston is a ninth-century town." Guest: "So? That doesn't answer my question." Read A Tale Of Two Cities
